name: Checklist Entity Reference
description: Adds an entity-reference field type rendered as a checklist (checkboxes), with a form 'Checklist Progress' pseudo-field and progress-bar formatters showing how many referenced items are selected.
project_description:
Currently you can add an entity reference field to any field-able entity, and you could use that to see where an entity is in a given taxonomy / node based checklist.

 We utilised this built in Drupal 8 functionality, and extended it to allow it to be used more effectively for checklist style functionality.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Disallow unchecking checked items in the checklist 
 Show when an item was checked 
 Show the user who ticked off the item 
 Add a progress bar to an entity form using the form display to drag in the checklist progress widget 
 The checklist progress widget shows a cumulative progress if multiple checklist fields exist on an entity 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 This module borrows UI from the well thought out Checklist API module, but allows a checklist to be added and make use of entities rather than its own structure.
